ev.q: As of June 24, 2015, 90 (46%) of 194 World Health Organization (WHO) member states were using IPV

six were planning to introduce IPV in the second quarter of 2015, 32 in the third quarter of 2015
102 (53%) had established dates for the introduction of IPV
As of June 24, 2015, 90 (46%) of 194 World Health Organization (WHO) member states were using IPV
